'''Tsuchimikado Arinaga''' (土御門 有脩) was a noble and {{ill|Onmyōji|fa|اونمیو-جی|ja|陰陽師|ko|음양사|vi|Âm Dương sư|zh|陰陽師|zh_yue|陰陽師|qid=Q2274163|lt=Onmyōji}} active during the {{ill|Sengoku Period (Japan)|ja|戦国時代|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sengoku period (Japan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q117415390}} and the {{ill|Azuchi–Momoyama period|en|Azuchi–Momoyama period|qid=Q319531|lt=Azuchi-Momoyama period}}. He was the head of the {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽寮|lt=Onmyōryō}} and the 30th head of the {{ill|Tsuchimikado clan|ja|土御門家 (安倍氏)|lt=Tsuchimikado family}}, which descended from the {{ill|Abe clan|ja|阿倍氏}}.

== Biography ==
Tsuchimikado Arinaga held the Ranks of {{ill|Junior Third Rank|ja|従三位}}, {{ill|Hisanagi|ja|非参議}}, and {{ill|Ministry of Justice (pre-modern Japan)|ja|刑部卿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gyōbukyō|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 刑部省|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q6867320}}. He was the head of a {{ill|Tōshōke|ja|堂上家|ko|당상가|zh|堂上家|zh_classical|堂上家|qid=Q11427847}} of the {{ill|Half-house (Kuge)|ja|半家|qid=Q11406995}} Rank, belonging to the {{ill|Abe clan|ja|阿倍氏}} lineage.

In {{ill|Tenmon|ja|天文|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenbun|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q21096812}} 11 ({{ill|1542|en|1542|qid=Q6520|lt=1542}}), during a period of war and instability, Arinaga left Kyoto and withdrew to his estate in {{ill|Natashō, Fukui|en|Natashō, Fukui|qid=Q6968522|lt=Nata-shō}}, {{ill|Wakasa Province|en|Wakasa Province|qid=Q1053713|lt=Wakasa Province}}. This led to his abandonment of duties as {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽頭|lt=Onmyō no kami}}. Consequently, {{ill|Kadenokōji Aritomi|ja|勘解由小路在富|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kadenokōji Akitomi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11400104}}, a noble of the {{ill|Kamo clan|ja|賀茂朝臣氏}} lineage residing in {{ill|Sagami Province|en|Sagami Province|qid=Q1053732|lt=Sagami Province}}, was summoned to Kyoto to take over the Onmyōryō's responsibilities.

=== Descendants===
The male-line descendants of {{ill|Abe no Seimei|en|Abe no Seimei|qid=Q1150151|lt=Abe no Seimei}} through Tsuchimikado Arinaga have largely been lost. Notably, the {{ill|Q11386816|ja|倉橋家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kurahashi family|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11386816}} (a cadet branch of the Abe clan) and the {{ill|Kajūji family|ja|勧修寺家|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kanjūji family|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11400595}} trace their lineage through Arinaga's children and subsequent marriages. The family line continued through daughter’s descendants and their connections to prominent aristocratic families, including the {{ill|Imperial House of Japan|ar|البيت الإمبراطوري في اليابان|as|জাপানৰ ৰাজপৰিয়াল|ast|Familia imperial xaponesa|az|Yaponiya imperator evi|be|Імператарскі дом Японіі|ca|Família Imperial del Japó|ckb|خێزانی شاھانەی ژاپۆن|cs|Japonská císařská dynastie|de|Japanisches Kaiserhaus|el|Αυτοκρατορικός Οίκος της Ιαπωνίας|eo|Japana reĝa familio|es|Familia imperial japonesa|fa|دودمان یاماتو|fr|Maison impériale du Japon|he|בית הקיסרות של יפן|hr|Japanska carska obitelj|hu|Japán császári ház|id|Wangsa Kekaisaran Jepang|it|Famiglia imperiale del Giappone|ja|皇室|ko|일본 황실|la|Domus imperatoriae Iaponiae|ms|Kerabat diraja Jepun|no|Japans keiserhus|pt|Casa Imperial do Japão|ro|Familia imperială a Japoniei|ru|Японский императорский дом|sh|Carska kuća Japana|simple|Imperial House of Japan|sq|Shtëpia Perandorake e Japonisë|th|ราชวงศ์ญี่ปุ่น|tr|Yamato Hanedanı|uk|Імператорський дім Японії|ur|جاپان کا شاہی خاندان|vi|Hoàng thất Nhật Bản|zh|日本皇室|zh_classical|日本皇室|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún hông-sek|zh_yue|日本皇室|qid=Q909452|lt=Imperial House of Japan}} from {{ill|Emperor Ninkō|en|Emperor Ninkō|qid=Q312351|lt=Emperor Ninkō}} onwards.
